ai_summary: A promoter of Ajanta Pharma Limited, Aayush Agrawal, has reported a net increase of 100,000 pledged equity shares, resulting from the creation of a pledge on 1,125,000 shares and the release of 1,025,000 shares. The new pledges were made for a "New Loan & Top up call," while the release was due to "Loan Closure." The "Top up call" reason, alongside the net increase in encumbered holdings, may signal increased personal leverage or potential liquidity needs for the promoter, warranting closer scrutiny.
